properties.name: separator
properties.comment: What the field's text puts between the checked items' texts, ", " by default. Invalid UTF-8 throws std::invalid_argument.

table.description: What the field's text puts between the checked items.

prepare: if (!validate_utf8(incoming).valid()) throw std::invalid_argument("CheckedComboBox separator must be valid UTF-8");

properties.name: placeholder_text
properties.comment: The hint the field shows while nothing is checked, such as "Any colour". Invalid UTF-8 throws std::invalid_argument.

table.description: The hint the field shows while nothing is checked.

prepare: if (!validate_utf8(incoming).valid()) throw std::invalid_argument("CheckedComboBox placeholder must be valid UTF-8");

properties.name: max_drop_down_items
properties.comment: The items the open list shows before it scrolls, from 1 to 64 (std::invalid_argument; MaxDropDownItems). A change applies the next time the list opens.

table.description: The items the open list shows before it scrolls.

prepare: if (incoming == 0U || incoming > 64U) throw std::invalid_argument("CheckedComboBox drop-down items must be from 1 to 64");

not_properties.name: items
not_properties.reason: records kept by stable ID, set through set_items

not_properties.name: text
not_properties.reason: read-only: the checked items' texts joined by the separator
